$comment: Extraction model parameters (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3). Rationals are strings. Every rate comes from the dataset; these are only multipliers and choices.

modularMiner.$comment: effective = max(minEffective, purity + (fluidBonus + boosterBonus) × processingMalus); baseRate = A_mk × 60 × effective. A_mk comes from MultiMachine PartsRatio of the chosen Mk.
modularMiner.$boosterPowerMW: R1: booster module power draw is unknown; 0 until provided.
modularMiner.$processingMalus: Crusher derived from dataset Fluid-Crusher rows; Smelter assumed equal (A3).
modularMiner.$allowProcessingWithFluid: A4: Crusher/Smelter + fluid allowed for every ore.
modularMiner.$machines: A11: no Fluid-Smelter machine exists in the dataset; its power is taken from the Fluid-Crusher machine.

nodeExtractors.$comment: Non-miner extractors on limited nodes run fully overclocked. Power scales as clock^exponent (machine OverclockPowerExponent, else defaultPowerExponent).

fracking.$comment: Per-site rate = siteNormalEquivalents × (extractor rate on a normal node) × clock, unless nodes.csv site_rate_m3_min overrides it (A6). 40/3 = mean normal-node-equivalents of the six SF+ Nitrogen clusters.
